name: SAMMY
description:
SAMMY is a software assurance maturity platform built on OWASP SAMM. Security teams use it to assess how mature their software security practices are, track progress against a target posture, and report across products and business units.

This connector lets Claude work with your SAMMY data directly: which scope is furthest from its target, which practices are weakest, what was answered for a given activity, how two products compare.

Alongside OWASP SAMM, SAMMY supports NIST SSDF, ISO 27001:2022, DSOMM, NIST CSF 2.0, PCI DSS and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SAMMY to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SAMMY to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sammy.codific.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SAMMY MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SAMMY provides these MCP tools: get_assessment, get_assessment_answers, get_assessment_detailed_scores, get_assessment_overall_scores, list_assessments, list_frameworks, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SAMMY?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SAMMY in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SAMMY requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SAMMY is developed by Codific. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
